verdict.rationale: Kong's hybrid architecture keeps the control plane out of the data path, and the data plane can be configured on-prem, with logs written locally. This implies you control where LLM traffic and logs live. However, there is no documented region or residency selection for hosted Konnect components such as analytics and logs. Missing for 10: explicit region/data-residency selection for hosted Konnect data, documentation of where control-plane analytics are stored, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: the control plane stays out of the data path: by default it doesn't see the LLM
By default, you can view AI Gateway logs at `/usr/local/kong/logs/error.log`. If you're running an AI Gateway data plane in Docker, you can also view them from your Docker container.
